name: nedCAPTCHA 2
description: Adds CAPTCHA protection to surveys. See full documentation here.

authors.name: Günther Rezniczek
authors.institution: St. Elisabethgruppe GmbH - Marien Hospital Herne, Klinikum der Ruhr-Universität Bochum

action-tags.description: Use this action tag on a Text Box-type field (without validation) on the first page of the public survey instrument to set up a CAPTCHA. The field's label will be used as the prompt for the CAPTCHA. Use the setup helper by clicking this action tag on the Online Designer fields view. Consider adding the @HIDDEN-FORM and @HIDDEN-PDF action tags to this field to prevent it from being shown on the data entry form or on the PDF (unless nedCAPTCHA 2 is set up to capture the response).

When added to a descriptive field on the first survey page only, this field's label will be shown instead of the survey instructions when the CAPTCHA is presented. Consider adding the @HIDDEN-FORM and @HIDDEN-PDF action tags to this field to prevent it from being shown on the data entry form or on the PDF.

Apply to a descriptive field on the first survey page only. This field will be hidden and only shown when the survey respondent fails the CAPTCHA. Consider adding the @HIDDEN-FORM and @HIDDEN-PDF action tags to this field to prevent it from being shown on the data entry form or on the PDF.

Apply to a descriptive field on the first survey page only. This field will remain visible while the CAPTCHA is presented. Consider adding the @HIDDEN-FORM and @HIDDEN-PDF action tags to this field to prevent it from being shown on the data entry form or on the PDF.

Only for CAPTCHAs of type Custom, apply to a text box field (without validation) on the first survey page. This field will be filled with the CAPTCHA challenge. This may be useful to implement your own custom CAPTCHA images that are shown in descriptive fields with branching logic based on the value of the random challenge. Consider adding the @HIDDEN and @HIDDEN-PDF action tags to this field to prevent it from being shown.

Only for CAPTCHAs of type Custom, apply to any field on the first survey page. This action tag takes a single string parameter that must correspond to a custom challenge value. When the matching challenge is displayed, this field will be embedded in place of the custom challenge. Non-matching challenges will be excluded from the page. Never combine this action tag with any of the other nedCAPTCHA action tags on the same field. Consider adding the @HIDDEN-FORM and @HIDDEN-PDF action tags to this field to prevent it from being shown.
